title: NEET UG 2025 — Official Question Paper
description: Complete National Eligibility cum Entrance Test (UG) 2025 (Booklet 45). 180 compulsory questions covering Physics, Chemistry, and Biology.

instructions.en: The question paper comprises 180 compulsory multiple choice questions: Physics (Q1-45), Chemistry (Q46-90), and Biology (Q91-180). Each correct answer carries +4 marks and -1 for wrong answer. Total time: 180 minutes. Maximum marks: 720.
